t: Din kira vetannur litten aleha haqqederot beereb shabbat
s: Din kira vetannur litten aleha haqqederot beereb shabbat ubo k"t seipim: kira shehi asuya keen qedera gedola, umassiqin otah betokah al shuleha, veshopetin al piha qedera lemala, vehi arukka uqetzara, veyesh bah lemala meqom shepitat b' qederot, im husseqa begepet, shehu pesolet shel zetim, o beetzim — asur litten aleha tabshil mibbeod yom lehashhoto aleha letzorek hallayla o ad lemachar, im keshemmaggia hallayla en hattabshil mebushshal adayin kemaakal ben derusai (perush shem adam listim shehaya okel tabshilo ap sheadayin lo nitbashshel kol tzorko), shemma yachteh (perush yenaer) vihappek haggechalim bemachta beshabbat ligmor bishshulo. Ella im ken hakkira hi gerupa, dehaynu sheggarap mimmenna kol haggechalim lachutz, o shehi qetuma, dehaynu shekkissa haggechalim baeper lemaet chummam. Veen tzarik liqtom ad shello yihyeh nikkar sham esh kelal, ella day biqtima kol shehu, vaapillu hubaru haggechalim achar kak mealehem — en bekak kelum, dekevan sheggilla dato mibbeod yom sheeno tzarik lehaggechalim — shub en lachush shemma yachteh beshabbat. Vehaggechalim sheamemu hare hen kiqtuma:
Veim husseqa beqash ubigbaba — muttar lehashhoto aleha ap al pi sheenah gerupa velo qetuma, lepi sheen begachale haqqash vehaggebaba mammashut kelal, veen lachush bahem shemma yachteh:

Vaapillu husseqa begepet veetzim — muttar lismok lah qedera besamuk chutza lah mibbeod yom lehashhotah sham letzorek hallayla o ad lemachar, ap al pi shekkeshemmaggia hallayla lo nitbashshela adayin kemaakal ben derusai, veen chosheshim shemma yachteh begechalim shebbetok hakkira kede lemaher bishshul haqqedera shechutza lah, sheen chittuy zeh moil lah kol kak. Ushette kirot hammatimot zo etzel zo vedopen shel cheres mapsiq benehem, haechad gerupa o qetuma vehashsheniyya enah gerupa velo qetuma — muttar lehashhot al gabbe haggerupa uqetuma, ap al pi shemmosip hebel mishsheenah gerupa uqetuma, lepi shezzehu kesomek chutza lah lesheenah gerupa uqetuma:

Vetannur shehu asuy keen qedera gedola rachab lematta vetzar lemala, umittok kak niqlat chummo letoko yoter mibbakkira — asur apillu lismok lo im hayyad soledet sham, apillu hu garup veqatum, vaapillu hussaq beqash o bigbaba, veen tzarik lomar lehashhot al gabbayv o betoko, demittok shehablo cham beyoter — eno massiach dato, vechosheshim shemma yachteh bezo haesh hammeutta ap al pi shehi esh qash ugebaba umekussa baeper:

Velama aseru betannur haggarup? Mippene shehaggorep eno gorep ella rob haesh (v)atzmah, vei epshar ligrop kol haesh ad shello tishshaer nitzotz echad, umippene shehablo cham beyoter — yesh lachush shemma yachteh lehabir hannitzotzot hannisharot battannur. Veim nitqarer hablo ad sheen hayyad soledet sham — muttar lehashhot sham betoko. Vekol shekken shemmuttar lehashhot al gabbayv o lismok chutza lo im en hayyad soledet bemaqom shemmashheh, vaapillu beshabbat atzmah muttar lehashhot sham. (Abal betok hattannur mammash o betok hakkira — asur litten sham beshabbat apillu tabshil shebbishshel kol tzorko, ap al pi shehen gerupim uqetumim vegam en hayyad soledet bahem kelal), kemo sheyyitbaer:

Vekuppach shehu asuy kekira, ella sheen bo lemala raq meqom shepitat qedera achat, umittok kak chummo gadol mechom hakkira, abal pachot hu min chom hattannur, im hussaq beqash o bigbaba — dino kekira shehusseqa beqash ugebaba, veim husseqa begepet veetzim — dino ketannur lekol dabar:

Vehattannurim shellanu sheppitcham min hatztzad — en hablam (merubbeh) cham kol kak kehebel hattannur shebbimehem, velo kehebel hakkuppach, hoil vehen rechabim yoter mishshepitat qedera achat, ulepikak hare dinam shaveh lekira lekol dabar:

Vekol zeh keshekkebar hitchil lehitbashshel mibbeod yom ella sheadayin lo nitbashshel kemaakal ben derusai, abal im hu chay legamre — muttar litteno apillu betok hattannur shehussaq begepet veetzim veeno garup veqatum, veen chosheshim shemma yachteh beshabbat, dekevan sheakshav hu chay hu massiach dato mimmennu ad lemachar, shebballayla lo yihyeh rauy adayin ap im yachteh begechalim, vekol hallayla ad lemachar yukal lehitbashshel ap belo chittuy kelal. Umikkol maqom, tzarik sheyyittenennu sham samuk lachasheka mammash, sheim netano sham mibod yom — kebar nitbashshel qetzat qodem kenisat shabbat, vetzarik lesalleqo mishshechasheka, ella im ken nitbashshel kebar kemaakal ben derusai qodem kenisat hashabbat, sheaz en lachush lechittuy sheap belo chittuy yekola lehitbashshel kol tzorkah letzorek hallayla, kevan shennitbashshela kebar chatzi bishshulah mibbeod yom, vegam hi reuya kebar leheakel al yede haddechaq bebishshul zeh shemmibbeod yom. Vaapillu im lo natan ella chatika achat chayya baqqedera shehitchila kebar lehitbashshel — muttar keillu hayeta kullah chayya, lepi sheal yede otah chatika massiach dato mikkol haqqedera ad lemachar. Vekol zeh bebasar chay, shei epshar lo lehitbashshel od letzorek hallayla, abal yaraq chay vekayyotze bo — asur lehashhoto, ella im ken nitbashshel kemaakal ben derusai mibbeod yom, lepi sheap shehu chay akshav — yakol hu lehitbashshel letzorek hallayla, veeno massiach dato mimmennu ad lemachar:

Veyesh omerim sheapillu tabshil shennitbashshel kemaakal ben derusai, o apillu nitbashshel kol tzorko ella shehu mitztammeq veyapeh lo, dehaynu sheyyapeh lo leadam vesameach bemah shehattabshil mitztammeq — chosheshin shemma yachteh beshabbat lemaher bishshulo, o kede sheyyehe mitztammeq, ulepikak dino shaveh lekol dabar leillu hitchil lehitbashshel velo nitbashshel adayin kemaakal ben derusai shennitbaer lemala. Ukebar nitpashshet hamminhag lehaqel kisbara harishona:

Vekol zeh kesheen haqqedera nogaat baggechalim, kegon sheyyoshebet al gabbe kisse shel barzel o al gabbe abanim betok hakkira o hattannur, abal im hi omedet al gabbe gechalim ap shehen omemot uqetumot — asur bekol inyan, ap im hu mitztammeq vera lo, dehaynu shera lo leadam veatzeb hu bezeh shehattabshil mitztammeq, o shehu chay legamre, lepi shezzeh niqra hatmana, shemmatmin al gabbe haggechalim, vehaggechalim hem mosipim hebel baqqedera, veasur lehatmin al gabbe dabar hammosip hebel, apillu mitztammeq vera lo o chay legamre, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman rn"z, ayyen sham hattaam. Veyesh choleqin al zeh veomerim shello aseru lehatmin al gabbe dabar hammosip hebel ella keshemmadbiq dabar hammittaltel sebib haqqedera, shehaqqedera kullah temuna beot[o] dabar, veap sheoto dabar eno mosip hebel, ella sheheemid haqqedera al gabbe dabar hammosip hebel — hare zeh asur keillu hayeta kullah temuna bedabar hammosip hebel, abal kan ap sheddopne hakkira o hattannur maqqipim sebib dopne haqqedera, veap im pihem satum lemala, mikkol maqom kevan sheen shum dabar hammittaltel dabuq sebib dopne haqqedera — en zeh niqra hatmana, mittaam sheyyitbaer besimman rn"z, veen shum issur bemah shehi omedet al gabbe dabar hammosip hebel. Veken hamminhag. Vaapillu im gechalim boarot maqqipot udebuqot sebib dopne haqqedera — en zeh hatmana, kevan shehu megulleh lemala. Ella sheaz asur leyisrael littol haqqedera mishsham beshabbat, lepi sheal yede netilat haqqedera hu mechatteh et haggechalim haelyonot venopelot al hattachtonot umekabbot otan, vehaelyonot hen nibarot mealehen al yede chittuy zeh. Veap shehu eno mitkavven lachtot, mikkol maqom pesiq resheh velo yamut hu, shei epshar littol haqqedera shello yachteh haggechalim. Umikkol maqom, muttar lomar lenokri littelah. Veap shekkol dabar sheasur laasoto beshabbat asur lomar lenokri laasoto, mikkol maqom kan shehaissur naaseh meelayv belo mitkavven, vehayyisrael eno omer lo kelal laasoto, ella sholecho laasot dabar hammuttar, im ken ap shemmeelayv naaseh haissur — hare lo naaseh bishlichut hayyisrael, shehayyisrael lo tzivvahu al kaka, vehannokri eno muzhar kelal al hashshabbat, ella sheasur lanu leshallecho laasot issur:

Veim haggechalim enan sebib haqqedera ella tachteha — min haddin muttar apillu leyisrael littelah, sheap im yenaanea qetzat haggechalim al yede netilat haqqedera — lo yubaru al yede kak velo yikbu. Veap shehen muqtzot, veasur letaltel hammuqtzeh apillu benianua kol shehu, mikkol maqom kevan sheeno menanean beyado ella al yede haqqedera — hare zeh niqra tiltul min hatztzad, veen bo issur kelal. Ella shemmikkol maqom lekattechilla lo yittelenna hayyisrael beatzmo, ella al yede nokri. Veim en sham nokri — yittelenna beatzmo. Veyizzaher littelah benachat, shello yachteh haggechalim, vegam shello yenaneen kelal (im epshar lo), lepi sheyyesh omerim sheapillu al yede nianua bilbad hen mitbaarot qetzat, vekevan shehu notelah benachat beinyan sheyyukal lihyot shello yenaneen kelal — en kan pesiq resheh velo yamut, ap im ap al pi ken hen mitnaanot — en bekak kelum sheddabar, sheeno mitkavven hu:

Kol maqom shennitbaer sheasur lehashhot tabshil shello nitbashshel kemaakal ben derusai, im abar veshiha apillu beshogeg, sheshshekachah sham, o shehaya sabur shehu muttar — asur ben lo ben laacherim ad sheyyamtinu bemotzae shabbat bikde sheyyeasu:

Shiur maakal ben derusai, yesh omerim shehu kemo shelish bishshul harauy lekol adam. Veyesh omerim shehu kemo chatzi bishshulo. Uleinyan halaka, ap al pi shebbedibre soperim hallek achar hammeqel, mikkol maqom mishshum chomer shabbat tzarik lizzaher lekattechilla sheyyitbashshel chatzi bishshulo mibbeod yom, im en sham echad middarke hahetter. Abal bediabad yesh lehattir hattabshil bekol inyan, im nitbashshel shelish bishshulo mibbeod yom:

Kira shehissiquha beqash ugebaba, o apillu begepet veetzim ella shehi gerupa uqetuma, venatal haqqedera mealeha, ben mibbeod yom ben mishshechasheka, uba lehachazirah aleha beshabbat, im odah beyado, shello hesirah miyyado keshennetalah meal hakkira ad shaa sherotzeh lehachazirah, velo pinna mimmenna hattabshil liqdera acheret, ella rotzeh lehachaziro keshehu beotah qedera shehayeta al hakkira — muttar lo lehachaziro (beshabbat), im battechilla keshennatal haqqedera meal hakkira haya bedato sheyyachazirenna achar kak, shennimtza shello botla adayin shehiyya harishona shehishha ota sham al hakkira mibbeod yom, kevan shebbishat silluqah mehakkira en dato leoqrah mimmenna legamre, ella lehachazirenna lah achar kak. Abal im battechilla keshennetalah lo haya dato lehachazirah lah, veken im hesira miyyado paam achat, o sheppinna hattabshil liqdera acheret — kebar botla lah shehiyya harishona, ukesherotzeh lehachazirah — hare zeh kemoshibah beshabbat battechilla, vachakamim lo hittiru ella chazara, abal lo lehoshib qedera battechilla beshabbat al hakkira, ap al pi shehi beinyan sheen bah mishshum issur bishshul, kegon shehi mebushshelet kebar kol tzorkah, sheen bishshul achar bishshul, umuttar lesomkah etzel hammedura apillu bemaqom shehayyad soledet bo, mikkol maqom keshemmaamidah al hakkira shehu maqom shedderek lebashshel sham — hare zeh nireh kimbashshel lekattechilla beshabbat. Umikkol maqom, keshehaya dato lehachazirah veodah beyado — muttar lehachazirah apillu lekira acheret, ap al pi shehablah merubbeh meharishona. Abal im battechilla hayeta temuna bederek sheyyitbaer besimman rn"z, ubeshabbat ba leoqrah mehatmana zo ulehoshibah lakkira — asur, shehare zeh kemoshib battechilla. Veken im hayeta bakkira, ubeshabbat ba littelah mehakkira ulehatminah apillu bekarim ukesatot o bishar begadim sheen mosipim hebel ella maamidin hahebel — asur, shehare zeh kematmin battechilla beshabbat, sheasur apillu bedabar sheeno mosip hebel, ella al derek sheyyitbaer besimman rn"z. Umikkol maqom, im en hakkarim vehakkesatot kerukim ella sebib dopne haqqedera, abal piha megulleh lemala — hare zeh muttar, sheen zeh derek hatmana:

Tannur shehissiquhu apillu beqash ubigbaba, vaapillu hu garup veqatum, shehishha alayv al pi echad middarke hahetter shennitbaaru lemala — asur lehachazir lo haqqedera beshabbat, ap al pi sheodah beyado vehaya dato lehachazirah, vaapillu hu mitztammeq vera lo, vehu haddin lekuppach shehissiquhu begepet veetzim, lepi sheddinam kekira shehusseqa begepet veetzim veenah gerupa uqetuma, sheasur lehachazir lah beshabbat bekol inyan, gezera shemma yachteh baggechalim. Veap shellehashhot meereb shabbat lo chasheshu lechittuy bemitztammeq vera lo, mikkol maqom leinyan chazara beshabbat atzmah hechemiru yoter:

Vekol zeh keshemmachazir haqqedera al gabbe pi hakkira milmala, sheddopne haqqedera boletin qetzat lemala middopne hakkira, abal lehachazirah letok hakkira mammash, vehu haddin letok hattannurim shellanu — asur bekol inyan, ap al pi shehussequ beqash ubigbaba, venigrepu veniqtemu, veotah haqqedera odah beyado, vehaya dato lehachazirah:
Veotan kirot sheen lahen tok vechalal ella hen peshutot vetokan vegabban echad — muttar lehachazir lahen:

Vaapillu al gabbe hakkira en hetter ella keshekkebar nitbashshel hammaakal kol tzorko, ap al pi shehu mitztammeq veyapeh lo, abal im adayin lo nitbashshel kol tzorko, ap al pi shekkebar nitbashshel yoter mikkemaakal ben derusai — asur lehachaziro beshabbat min hattora, mippene shehu mebashshel mammash. Vaapillu im nitbashshel kol tzorko ella shekkebar nitztannen legamre — asur lehachaziro bekol inyan, apillu im hu beinyan sheen bo mishshum issur bishshul, kegon shehu tabshil yabesh sheen bo maraq kelal, shekkeshehu mebushshal kol tzorko en bo mishshum issur bishshul ledibre hakkol ap shennitztannen legamre kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shy"ch, mikkol maqom al gabbe hakkira asur lehachaziro, dekevan shennitztannen legamre — botla lah shehiyya harishona, vahare zeh kemoshib beshabbat lekattechilla:

Abal im hu cham qetzat ap al pi sheen hayyad soledet bo — muttar lehachaziro im hu beinyan sheen bo mishshum issur bishshul, kegon shehu yabesh sheen bo maraq, shelledibre hakkol en bo mishshum bishshul ap im haya tzonen legamre. Vaapillu im yesh bo maraq sheyyesh bo mishshum bishshul im nitztannen legamre, mikkol maqom keshello nitztannen legamre nohagim lehaqel leinyan lesomko keneged hammedura kemo sheyyitbaer sham, im ken hu haddin sheyyesh lehattir lepi zeh lehachaziro al gabbe hakkira haggerupa o qetuma, o shehusseqa beqash o gebaba, vehaqqedera odah beyado vehaya dato lehachazirah. Abal hamminhag lehaqel od apillu lehachazir tok tannurim shellanu sheddinam ketok hakkira, umachazirim gam leachar shehesir haqqedera miyyado vehinnichah al gabbe qarqa veshahata sham harbeh vegam lo haya dato battechilla lehachazirah, vaapillu pinna hattabshil liqdera acheret. Veen limchot beyadam, lepi sheyyesh omerim shello hitzriku chakamim sheyyihyeh dato lehachazirah veodah beyado ella beshennetalah mehakkira mibbeod yom uba lehachazirah beshabbat, sheaz im lo haya dato lehachazirah o shekkebar hesirah miyyado — hare zeh kemoshibah beshabbat lekattechilla, kevan shebbitchillat kenisat hashshabbat lo hayeta sham kelal al hakkira, abal keshennetalah mehakkira mishshechasheka, kevan shebbitchillat kenisat shabbat haya tabshil zeh al hakkira — eno nireh kemoshibo beshabbat battechilla, ap im lo hayeta dato lehachazirah, vegam kebar hesirah miyyado upinnahu liqdera acheret, velaken muttar lehachazirah im husseqa beqash ugebaba, o shehi gerupa o qetuma, vehattabshil nitbashshel kol tzorko velo nitztannen legamre. Veal zeh somekim haolam lehaqel yoter velomar, sheap mah sheaseru chakamim lehachazir letokah — lo aseru ella keshennetalah mimmenna mibbeod yom vehayeta beyado ad leachar shechasheka. Umikkol maqom, kol adam yesh lo lehachamir leatzmo shello lehachazir letok hakkira vehattannur ap shennetalah mishsham leachar shechasheka, ap al pi shehayeta dato lehachazirah veodah beyado, lepi sheen taam maspiq lechalleq ben netalah mishshechasheka uben netalah mibbeod yom leinyan chazara letokah. Vaapillu leinyan lehachazir al gabbe hakkira, im lo haya bedato lehachazirah, o shekkebar hesirah miyyado, o sheppinna liqdera acheret — tob lehachamir, lepi sherabbu haomerim sheap leinyan zeh en chilluq ben netalah mibbeod yom lintalah mishshechasheka. Veyesh nohagim lehaqel od lehachazir lemachar bayyom letok hattannur sheapu bo mibbeod yom ap al pi shello gerapuhu, im lo chimmemu od hattannur achar haapiyya lehatmin bo hachammin shel seuddat shacharit, ella hitminu betannur acher, lepi shehaggechalim shennisharu min hachimmum shechimmemuhu letzorek haapiyya kebar kahu veamemu, vahare hen kigrupot (umikkol maqom, im hayyad soledet sham — asur) kemo shennitbaer lemala. Veyish meqillin od, daapillu hitminu bo hachammin, mikkol maqom achar seuddat shacharit bevadday amemu kol gechalayv, umuttar lehachazir letoko lepi hamminhag (im en hayyad soledet sham):

Vekol zeh lehachazir al gabbah o letokah, abal muttar lismok etzlah chutza lah beshabbat, veken etzel hattannur shellanu ap im gup hattabshil nogea bedopen hattannur min hatztzad, vaapillu hussaq begepet veetzim veeno garup veqatum, sheen lachush lechittuy besomek chutza lo kemo shennitbaer lemala. Vaapillu kebar silleq tabshil zeh mehattannur mibbeod yom vehinnicho al gabbe qarqa, velo haya dato lehachaziro letoko, velo apillu lesomko etzlo, vaapillu hu tabshil yashan venitztannen legamre, ella shehu beinyan sheen bo mishshum bishshul, kegon shehu yabesh — hare zeh muttar lismok, lepi sheeno nireh kimbashshel beshabbat lekattechilla, sheen derek lebashshel chutz lehattannur vehakkira, vahare dino kesomek keneged hammedura sheyyitbaer besimman shy"[ch]. Veyesh oserim lismok etzel kira o tannur shellanu sheenan gerupim uqetumim vehussequ begepet veetzim, ap shehayeta dato lehachazirah o lesomkah veodah beyado, mishshum gezera shemma yachteh, sheap shelleinyan lismok sham mibbeod yom lo chasheshu lechittuy, mikkol maqom leinyan lismok beshabbat hechemiru yoter. Vehamminhag kisbara harishona. Umikkol maqom, bemaqom sheen sham tzorek kol kak — tob lachush ledibrehem:

Vekol zeh keshemmachazir beshabbat lemaqom shehayyad soledet sham (dehaynu sheim tabshil zeh shemmachazir haya tzonen — haya yakol lehitchammem sham kol kak ad shehayyad soledet bo), abal im en hayyad soledet sham — ledibre hakkol muttar lismok sham, apillu battannur shebbimehem, ap al pi sheeno garup veqatum. Vaapillu al gabbe hakkira haggerupa o qetuma muttar lehachazir im en hayyad soledet sham, ap al pi shekkebar silleq tabshil zeh mibbeod yom vehinnicho al gabbe qarqa velo haya bedato lehachaziro kelal, vaapillu pinnahu liqdera acheret, vaapillu hu tabshil yashan venitztannen legamre, vaapillu yesh bo maraq, lepi shekkesheen sham chom kol kak shehayyad soledet bo — eno nireh kimbashshel sham lekattechilla. (Abal leinyan lehachazir letok hakkira o letok hattannur apillu shellanu — en chilluq ben hayyad soledet bo leen hayyad soledet bo):

Vekol zeh lehachazir beshabbat atzmah, abal im aqar haqqedera meal gabbe hakkira mibbeod yom, venimlak vehechezirah samuk lachasheka qodem qabbalat shabbat, ap al pi shekkebar hinnichah al gabbe qarqa, vaapillu nitztanena legamre, vaapillu pinnahu liqdera acheret — yakol lehachazirah apillu letokah, o apillu letok hattannur shebbimehem, ap al pi sheeno garup veqatum. Veyesh omerim shekkol shehu samuk lachasheka kol kak sheim hayeta haqqedera tzonenet lo haya epshar lehartichah mibbeod yom — asur lehachazirah lekira zo velo lekira acheret, ap sheakshav hi rotachat, ella al derek shemmuttar lehachazir beshabbat atzmah, mishshum gezera shemma yabou lehachazir ap beshabbat atzmah. Abal im haya yakol lehartichah mibbeod yom, ella sheen shahut lehartichah qodem qabbalat shabbat — en bekak kelum. Vehamminhag lehaqel legamre kisbara harishona. Umikkol maqom, bemaqom sheen sham tzorek kol kak — tob lehachamir. Velaken tob lizzaher shello littol haqqedera mehakkira o hattannur shennitbashshela sham velittenah samuk lachasheka al gabbe tannur bet hachorep shehu eno garup veqatum im hayyad soledet sham, ella im ken manniach sham shum dabar tachat haqqedera kemo shetztzarik lehanniach beshabbat atzmah, kemo sheyyitbaer:

Abal lismok etzel tannur sheeno garup veqatum samuk lachasheka, ap al pi shehayyad soledet sham — muttar ledibre hakkol, ap al pi sheyyesh oserim beshabbat atzmah. Vekol shekken lismok keneged hammedura bemaqom shehayyad soledet bo, sheapillu beshabbat atzmah muttar im hu beinyan sheen bo mishshum bishshul kemo shekkatub besimman shy"ch, vesamuk lachasheka muttar ap im hu beinyan sheyyesh bo mishshum bishshul, kegon sheyyesh bo maraq venitztannen legamre, o apillu adayin lo nitbashshel kemaakal ben derusai. Veim hu chay legamre — muttar apillu lehachaziro al gabbe kira sheenah gerupa uqetuma samuk lachasheka mammash ledibre hakkol, shebbechay en lachush kelal lechittuy, kemo shennitbaer lemala:

Im abar vehechezir beshabbat lemaqom sheasur lehachazir (sham ledibre hakkol), ben beshogeg ben bemezid — asur ad motzae shabbat bikde sheyyeasu. Bammeh debarim amurim? Bemitztammeq veyapeh lo, abal im mitztammeq vera lo — muttar apillu bo bayyom, shehare lo neheneh min haissur. Veyesh mistappeqin apillu bemitztammeq veyapeh lo im yesh leesor kelal bediabad im haya shogeg baddabar, meachar shehaya mebushshal kebar kol tzorko. Veyesh lismok al zeh lehattir laacherim shello huchzar bishbilam. Umikkol maqom, libne beto en lehattir, sheggam bishbilam huchzar:

Vekol zeh keshehechezir hayyisrael beatzmo, abal im hechezir al yede nokri, apillu bemezid, muttar apillu mitztammeq veyapeh lo, im haya mebushshal kol tzorko, sheeno neheneh mimmennu kol kak, kevan shekkebar haya rauy leekol. Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshehaya cham qetzat mittechilla, shehaya rauy leekol, abal im haya tzonen legamre, shello haya rauy leekol, vechimmemo hannokri apillu meatzmo beshabbat bishbil yisrael bemaqom sheasur lehachazir sham beshabbat (ledibre hakkol), vehayyisrael baal hattabshil raa veshataq, kevan shehoilu maaseh hannokri — asur lekol adam leoklo apillu leachar sheyyitztannen, ad sheyyamtinu bemotzae shabbat bikde sheyyeasu. Abal im hayyisrael baal hattabshil lo yada keshehecheziro hannokri shehu tzonen legamre, o shello raahu kelal keshehecheziro — hare zeh muttar, shemmin hassetam en hayyisrael rotzeh kelal sheyyechammem hannokri et tabshilo leachar shennitztannen legamre, velo kol hemennu sheyyeesor et hattabshil shel yisrael beal korcho. (Vaapillu im tzivva et hannokri lehachazir) im hechezir (apillu hayyisrael beatzmo) lemaqom sheyyesh mattirim apillu lekattechilla, kegon shessamak etzel tannur sheeno garup veqatum o keneged hammedura, tabshil shennitbashshel kol tzorko veyesh bo maraq venitztannen legamre, venitchammem sham ad shehayyad soledet bo, sheap al pi sheyyesh bah chiyyub chattat (leyisrael), mikkol maqom kevan sheyyesh mattirim apillu lekattechilla kemo shekkatub besimman shy"ch — yesh lismok al dibrehem bediabad (shello leesor maaseh hannokri, apillu tzivvahu yisrael):

Hammashkim babboqer veraa shehiqdicha tabshilo shebbiqdera sheal pi hakkira sheenah gerupa uqetuma, shehishha aleha beechad middarke hahetter shennitbaaru lemala, umityare pen yaqdiach yoter — yakol lehasir haqqedera mehakkira ulehanniach qedera yeshana reqanit al pi hakkira, [velo] chadasha mittaam sheyyitbaer besimman tq"b, veaz yasim haqqedera shehattabshil betokah al gabbe haqqedera hareqanit. Veen kan issur bemah shemmachazir beshabbat lekira sheenah gerupa uqetuma, dekevan shehaqqedera hareqanit sotemet pi hakkira tachat haqqedera shehattabshil betokah — hare zeh kigrupa uqetuma. Veken muttar litten tabshil beshabbat al pi qederat chammin hattemuna al gabbe haesh (shebbakkira) al derek sheyyitbaer besimman rn"z, ap al pi shehayyad soledet sham, veen chosheshin lechittuy baggechalim, kevan shehaqqedera mapseqet ben tabshil zeh lehaggechalim. Vaapillu im hesir tabshil zeh mehakkira mibbeod yom, velo haya bedato lehachaziro, vehinnicho al gabbe qarqa, vaapillu pinnahu miqqedera liqdera, vaapillu hu tabshil yashan venitztannen legamre, ella shehu beinyan sheen bo mishshum bishshul, kegon sheen bo maraq, sheap shebbekol echad meellu asur lehachaziro beshabbat apillu al gabbe kira haggerupa uqetuma, mippene shennireh kimbashshel lekattechilla beshabbat, mikkol maqom keshemmannicho al gabbe haqqedera sheal gabbe haggechalim (shebbakkira) — eno nireh kimbashshel lekattechilla, lepi sheen derek bishshul bekak. Ulepi zeh yesh lomar betannur shellanu sheyyesh alayv maaziba, sheap im eno garup veqatum, veken tannur bet hachorep sheeno garup veqatum, vaapillu haesh betoko — muttar litten al gabbayv beshabbat ap al pi shehayyad soledet sham kol mah shemmuttar litten al pi qedera hattemuna al gabbe haggechalim, kevan shehammaaziba mapseqet ben haesh lehaqqedera shehattabshil betokah. Veyesh omerim sheap al pi sheen hayyad soledet sham tzarik sheyyanniach atta shum dabar tachat haqqedera lehapsiq benah lehaggechalim shebbattannur, kede sheyyihyeh lo hekker bezeh velo yabo lachtot, abal hammaaziba shehi asuya mikkebar enah chashuba hepseq vehekker lemono millachtot. Veken iqqar. Umikkol maqom, qodem shehussaq hattannur nahagu lehaqel litten al gabbayv belo hepseq, ap al pi sheyyitchammem achar kak kesheyyussaq, veaz yihyeh chashash shemma yachteh — ap al pi ken en limchot beyadam, kevan sheyyesh lahem al mi sheyyismoku:

Abal lismok etzel tannur bet hachorep sheeno garup veqatum, vaapillu haesh betoko — muttar bekol inyan lepi minhagenu, kemo shennitbaer lemala, raq sheyyihyeh hattabshil cham qetzat im yesh bo maraq vehayyad soledet bemaqom shessomek lattannur, abal im en hayyad soledet sham etzel hattannur, ap al pi shennitztannen hattabshil legamre — muttar lismok bekol inyan, kemo shennitbaer lemala. Umikkol maqom, im yodea shehannokri yassiq achar kak et hattannur lechammem et habbayit, shezzehu muttar beshabbat al derek sheyyitbaer besimman ra"v, ukesheyyitchammem hattannur meod yitchammem gam ken hattabshil sheetzlo ad shehayyad soledet bo — asur lehannicho sham, ella yittelennu mishsham qodem sheyyassiq hannokri, lepi shezzehu keechad manniach et haqqedera veechad noten et haur shettachteha, sheharishon patur abal asur middibre soperim:

Abal muttar lomar lenokri sheyyanniach sham et hattabshil, veachar kak yassiq hattannur lechammem habbayit, venirtach hattabshil meelayv, lepi sheiqqar kavvanat hannokri behassiqo enah bishbil hattabshil, ella bishbil chimmum habbayit, shehu dabar hammuttar, vehattabshil nirtach meelayv. Veap shehu pesiq resheh velo yamut — en bezeh issur baamira lenokri, mittaam shennitbaer lemala. Veyesh mi sheoser bazeh, kevan shehannokri mitkavven behassiqo gam bishbil hattabshil, shehare hinnicho al gabbe hattannur o etzlo, ap sheiqqar kavvanato bishbil habbayit — en zeh moil kelum. Vehamminhag kisbara harishona. Umikkol maqom, kol baal nepesh yachmir leatzmo bemaqom sheen sham tzorek kol kak:

Abal im natan nokri mayim letok haqqedera haqqebua battannur kede shello tibbaqa kesheyyassiq hattannur, veachar kak hissiq hattannur venirtechu hammayim — muttar lehanot hayyisrael mehem beshabbat. Vaapillu lekattechilla muttar lomar lo sheyyitten mayim baqqedera qodem sheyyassiq hattannur ledibre hakkol, shehare en kavvanato kelal lechammem hammayim ella lechammem habbayit, sheen notenim mayim biqdera ella kede shello tibbaqa haqqedera. (Umikkol maqom, im hayyisrael chapetz beotan hammayim sheyyitchammemu lehadiach bahem kelim — asur lomar lenokri sheyyittenem laqqedera, dekevan shehayyisrael beatzmo asur lo littenam sham apillu samuk lachasheka im chapetz bahem lahadachat kelim), mishshum gezera shemma yachteh baggechalim leachar sheyyussaq hattannur kemo sheyyitbaer besimman rn"d — asur lomar lenokri littenam sham, shekkol dabar middebarim ellu shennitbaaru besimman zeh sheasur laasoto mishshum gezera shemma yachteh, o mishshum shennireh kimbashshel battechilla — asur lomar lenokri laasoto. Vaapillu im en lo chepetz kelal bammayim sheyyitchammemu — asur lo litten hammayim beatzmo apillu qodem shehussaq hattannur: ulepi hamminhag shennahagu kisbara harishona (disip k"ch), ap im kavvanato bintinat hammayim kede lechammemam — muttar, kevan sheiqqar kavvanato behassiqo hu bishbil habbayit. Veim natan hammayim baqqedera leachar shehissiq hattannur, ap al pi shehayeta haqqedera tzonenet adayin keshennatan bah hammayim, im yadua beberur shennetanan kede lechammemam — hare hem asurim ad motzae shabbat bikde sheyyeasu ledibre hakkol, kedin nokri sheasa melaka gemura bishbil yisrael, abal min hassetam lo netanan ella kede shello tibbaqa haqqedera:
